name_zh: 卡布斯/阿曼/现代化/中立/调解/香料/苏丹/马斯喀特/中立
core_mode: M625 苏丹现代化/中立调解/香料外交/马斯喀特/海湾调解
intellectual_tradition: 海湾国家现代化/中立外交/香料贸易/调解外交/稳定治理
description_zh: 卡布斯·本·赛义德（1940-2020）自1970年统治阿曼。他实现了从传统部落国家向现代君主制国家的转型，保持国家中立地位，在地区事务中发挥重要调解作用。阿曼在香料贸易和海洋外交中扮演重要角色。
description_en: Qabus bin Said (1940-2020) ruled Oman from 1970 until his death. He transformed Oman from a traditional tribal state to a modern monarchy, maintaining neutrality in regional affairs while playing a significant mediating role. Oman played crucial roles in spice trade and maritime diplomacy.
reason_zh: 卡布斯的治理智慧体现了稳定转型和外交平衡。通过保持中立和调解角色，阿曼在地区事务中发挥了重要作用。香料贸易和海洋外交是其软实力基础。
reason_en: Qabus's governance wisdom exemplified stability and diplomatic balance. Through neutrality and mediation, Oman played crucial role in regional affairs. Spice trade and maritime diplomacy formed the foundation of its soft power.

中立外交立场：1970-2020 地区事务中立/国际调解/避免卷入地区冲突/保持国家独立性
香料贸易与海洋外交：传统香料贸易/海洋航线/外交斡旋/地区和平渠道
社会稳定发展：1985-2020 社会经济发展/教育普及/医疗保健/文化保护
steps_en: State modernization: 1970-1985 Economic reforms/infrastructure development/education expansion/administrative system reform
Neutral diplomatic stance: 1970-2020 Regional neutrality/mediation/avoiding regional conflicts/maintaining independence
Spice trade and maritime diplomacy: Traditional spice trade/maritime routes/diplomatic mediation/regional peace channels
Social stability development: 1985-2020 Social development/education expansion/healthcare/cultural protection
expected_zh: 实现国家现代化和稳定发展，通过中立外交在地区事务中发挥重要调解作用。
expected_en: Achieve state modernization and stable development, play significant mediating role in regional affairs through neutral diplomacy.
